manifest.name: Entropy FM
manifest.description: Plays the history of your Home Assistant as generative soundscapes: every area is an artist, every day an album, and each album holds one slowly evolving piece in five styles. It only reads from Home Assistant and synthesises the audio while it plays. When the rooms you show change, it asks Music Assistant to re-sync its own items.

use_ha_plugin.label: Use the Home Assistant plugin
use_ha_plugin.description: Read Home Assistant through the Home Assistant plugin of Music Assistant, which must be set up. Turn this off to connect with a URL and a token of your own.

url.label: Home Assistant URL
url.description: The address of Home Assistant, such as http://homeassistant.local:8123. Only used when the plugin is not used.

token.label: Long-lived access token
token.description: A long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile. Only used when the plugin is not used.

verify_ssl.label: Verify the certificate
verify_ssl.description: Check the certificate of Home Assistant when the URL uses https.

days.label: Days to browse
days.description: How many days back you can browse, search and have in the library, from 1 to 10. Home Assistant's recorder keeps 10 days by default. Days you hearted stay, however old.

render_quality.label: Render quality
render_quality.description: How much of the processor a second of music may use. Light suits a Raspberry Pi, Standard a small server, Rich a PC. Light has fewer layers, fewer saws in the big voices and a cheaper room; Rich adds a long hall and a shimmer. Auto runs a short benchmark when the provider starts and picks the richest that would use less than 30 percent of one core, measured with the dearest style that you offer.

audio_cache_mb.label: Audio cache size (MB)
audio_cache_mb.description: Rendered tracks of past days are kept as Opus audio in Ogg files in the cache of the server, so that playing them again costs no processor and can be seeked. The oldest used are deleted above this size. Shortly after midnight, and once after the start, the tracks of the day that just ended are rendered into it for the rooms you keep every day of and for the days and tracks you hearted, in every style you offer. This works one track at a time at low priority, waits while a track plays and never fills more than 80 percent of the cache. 0 turns the cache and the pre-render off.

styles.label: Styles offered
styles.description: Which styles each soundscape comes in: Ambient, Berlin School, Lo-fi, Ritual and Cinematic Glitch. Every style is a version of the same day, such as "Dishwasher at Dusk (Lo-fi)", so you can compare them.

day_character.label: Character of the day
day_character.description: Let every day have its own character: weekday or weekend and how much was going on set the density, how warm it was picks the mode, the key walks the circle of fifths from week to week and the season brightens or darkens the sound. Unusual moments (a door at night, a washing machine on a strange day) become a swell, a dip of the filters and a change of harmony. Off: the plain sound; no extra history is read.

include_presence.label: Include presence
include_presence.description: Also let persons and device trackers play, which tells who is home. Off by default.

exclude.label: Extra exclusions
exclude.description: Entities to keep out of the music: patterns on the entity id, separated by commas, such as sensor.bedroom_*, light.hall_*. Persons, device trackers, locks, alarm panels, cameras and anything with password or code in its id are always left out.

role_overrides.label: Role overrides
role_overrides.description: Choose the role of an entity yourself, one `entity_id=role` per line, such as `sensor.geschirrspueler_power=dishwasher`. Roles: dishwasher, washer, washing_machine, dryer, drum, drone, fridge, oven, temperature, humidity, co2, air, pluck, chord, blip, pad, event, hob, media, cover, progress, sun, mute. You can also label an entity or its device `entropy_fm_dishwasher` (and so on) in Home Assistant; a label wins over this list.

rooms.label: Rooms to show
rooms.description: Rooms that appear in Music Assistant. None ticked shows every room, also rooms added later.

keep_rooms.label: Keep every day forever
keep_rooms.description: Days of these rooms are saved permanently, even after Home Assistant purges its history. Does not show or hide rooms.

errors.plugin_missing: Entropy FM needs the Home Assistant plugin of Music Assistant: add and connect it under Settings > Providers, or turn off 'Use the Home Assistant plugin' and enter a URL and a long-lived access token
errors.connection_missing: Enter the URL and a long-lived access token of Home Assistant
errors.login_refused: Home Assistant did not accept the access token
